plugin.name: macOS / CrossOver / D3DMetal (Recommended for Mac)
plugin.description: Optimized for running Skyrim on macOS via CrossOver, Wine, and Apple Game Porting Toolkit (D3DMetal / DXVK). Automatically utilizes Darwin libc scalable unified memory allocator and suppresses blocking Win32 modal message boxes that freeze the Metal presentation surface.

plugin.name: Native Windows Standard
plugin.description: Standard configuration for native Windows 10/11 installations. Enables Intel TBB memory manager overrides when tbbmalloc.dll is present, MaxStdIO (8192 file handles), waterflow animation stabilization, and distant tree LOD caching.

plugin.name: Performance & Clean Preset
plugin.description: Enables automatic orphaned SKSE cosave cleanup (bCleanSKSECoSaves), disables chargen precaching (for RaceMenu users), enables form and tree LOD caching, and ensures clean safe exit on quitting to desktop.
